name: Facet Type Tray
description: Exposes Type Tray content-type category groupings as a hierarchical Search API facet, with plugins to index, label, order and nest the categories.
project_description: Integrates the Type Tray content type organizer with the Facets and Search API modules, so the content-type categories defined in Type Tray can be used as a hierarchical facet in Search API views. Content types must have a Type Tray category assigned to appear grouped in the facet; types without a category are indexed under their own machine name. The module ships four plugins: a Search API processor (id 'type_tray') that indexes each node's category as a string field, storing both the parent category key (e.g. 'resources') and a compound 'category.bundle' value (e.g. 'resources.page'); a Facets build processor (id 'type_tray', 'Type Tray: Merge node types') that resolves those indexed raw values back to human-readable labels for display; a Facets sort processor (id 'type_tray_category', 'Sort by Type Tray categories') that orders facet results by the category order defined in type_tray.settings; and a Facets hierarchy plugin (id 'type_tray', 'Type Tray hierarchy') that treats categories as parents and content types (bundles) as children for a two-level widget. The module declares no routes, permissions, forms, config objects, config schema, entities or Drush commands; its plugins read Type Tray configuration and node-type third-party settings.
